---
title: "Lightbox: preview parity"
# bd-kcpkgftw. The lightbox links are added in the q2-preview pipeline too,
# so the preview's <main> matches the render's (no GLightbox runtime in the
# preview; a click there is inert). Explicit inline image plus an image
# alone in its paragraph, so no figure chrome is involved.
lightbox: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      dom-parity: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - - 'p > a.lightbox[data-gallery="quarto-lightbox-gallery-1"] > img[src="images/mv-0.png"]'
          - 'p > a.lightbox[data-gallery="g"][data-desc-position="left"] > img[src="images/mv-1.png"]'
        - []
---

Some text with an ![inline](images/mv-0.png){.lightbox} image.
